title: The Sun Stands Still

questions.question: Which king formed an alliance to attack Gibeon?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:1, 3 (ESV): "As soon as Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, heard how Joshua had captured Ai... he sent to Hoham king of Hebron..."

questions.question: How many kings attacked Gibeon?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:5 (ESV): "So the five kings of the Amorites... gathered their forces and went up..."

questions.question: What did Joshua do when Gibeon asked for help?
options: He went up from Gilgal with all the fighting men
He sent only a few men
questions.correctAnswer: He went up from Gilgal with all the fighting men
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:7 (ESV): "So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him..."

questions.question: What miracle happened during the battle?
options: The sun stood still and the moon stopped
questions.correctAnswer: The sun stood still and the moon stopped
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:13 (ESV): "And the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, until the nation took vengeance on their enemies."

questions.question: What else did the Lord use to kill the enemies?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:11 (ESV): "...the Lord threw down large stones from heaven on them... there were more who died because of the hailstones..."

questions.question: In what book is the sun standing still written?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:13 (ESV): "Is this not written in the Book of Jashar?"

questions.question: Where did the five kings hide?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:16 (ESV): "These five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah."

questions.question: What did Joshua command his captains to do to the kings?
options: Put your feet on their necks
questions.correctAnswer: Put your feet on their necks
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:24 (ESV): "...Come near and put your feet on the necks of these kings..."

questions.question: What happened to Makkedah and its king?
options: Devoted to destruction, let none remain
questions.correctAnswer: Devoted to destruction, let none remain
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:28 (ESV): "As for Makkedah... he devoted it to destruction and every person that was in it; he left none remaining."

questions.question: About how long did the sun stay in the midst of heaven?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:13 (ESV): "The sun stopped in the midst of heaven and did not hurry to set for about a whole day."

questions.question: Which cities were conquered in the southern campaign in this chapter?
options: Makkedah, Libnah, Lachish, Eglon, Hebron, Debir
questions.correctAnswer: Makkedah, Libnah, Lachish, Eglon, Hebron, Debir
questions.explanation: Joshua 10 lists these cities progressively conquered.

questions.question: Who came to help Lachish but was defeated?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:33 (ESV): "Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish. And Joshua struck him..."

questions.question: Why did the Lord fight for Israel?
options: He heeded the voice of a man
questions.correctAnswer: He heeded the voice of a man
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:14 (ESV): "There has been no day like it before or since, when the Lord heeded the voice of a man, for the Lord fought for Israel."

questions.question: Where did the army return to after the campaign?
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:43 (ESV): "Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal."

questions.question: Why was Gibeon considered a great city?
options: It was like one of the royal cities and greater than Ai, and all its men were warriors
questions.correctAnswer: It was like one of the royal cities and greater than Ai, and all its men were warriors
questions.explanation: Joshua 10:2 (ESV): "...because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were warriors."

key_verse_text: There has been no day like it before or since, when the LORD heeded the voice of a man, for the LORD fought for Israel. (ESV)
